scope: Mocked provider responses and in-process worker persistence fakes only; no external EAS request or database access
checks: GraphQL errors fail with a sanitized provider exception
Partial data accompanied by GraphQL errors is rejected
Invalid JSON, non-object payloads, and missing data objects are rejected
HTTP status failures propagate and provider responses close on every path
A missing attestations field fails before bounded persistence or cursor advancement
Valid data is returned unchanged to the worker
limitations: No live provider contract was exercised
Offset-pagination movement and earlier-than-cursor arrivals remain open
This does not establish EAS runtime/provider parity or MAN-CAP-040/047 acceptance
